display.purpose: Figures only: the hero available balance, metric tiles, sheet amounts. Never a heading.

headline.purpose: Landing-page h1 (Accounts, Exec, auth, paused page on desktop).

title.purpose: Default page h1 and outcome screens; one per page, focusable.

figure.purpose: The 20px tabular balance on an account card.

body.purpose: The 16px primary line of a list row and every form control; the browser base.

supporting.purpose: The 14px size for everything around a primary line: descriptions, cells, secondary lines, buttons at 500.

label.purpose: Tags, badges, timestamps, tab captions, chip counts.

eyebrow.purpose: Uppercase tracked step indicators, date-group labels and the OPS / EXEC header badge.

caption.purpose: 10px uppercase captions on card art only.

shadows.name: whisper
shadows.purpose: Every card and tile at rest; a paper cue, not depth.

shadows.name: acknowledge
shadows.purpose: Clickable card hover, with the border warming to 40% ring colour.

shadows.name: held
shadows.purpose: Dropdown menus and the bank card art.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Dialogs and sheets over a 40% black scrim.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: The only easing: success tick strokes and colour transitions.

motion.name: duration-colour
motion.purpose: Hover and focus colour transitions on controls, rows and nav (motion-safe only).

motion.name: duration-sheet
motion.purpose: Transaction sheet slide-in from bottom (mobile) or right (desktop).

motion.name: duration-tick-check
motion.purpose: Success tick check draw, after the ring.

motion.name: skeleton-pulse
motion.purpose: Every pending block; never a shimmer.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce lands on the final state

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that moves money or commits a step. Brand fill, no hover change.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius); font: 500 14px/1.43 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: default; user-select: none; transition: color 150ms, background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: The secondary action and the user-menu trigger: paper fill, hairline border, linen hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius); font: 500 14px/1.43 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: default; user-select: none; transition: color 150ms, background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); border-color: var(--border); outline: none; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { opacity: .5; pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); }

components.name: Ghost Button

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: A 10% Brick Refusal tint with coloured text; never a solid red fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius); font: 500 14px/1.43 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: default; user-select: none; transition: color 150ms, background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive) 10%, transparent); color: var(--destructive); outline: none; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-destructive:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-destructive:disabled { opacity: .5; pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive) 20%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Transparent fill, hairline stroke, 32px tall, ring on focus, Brick Refusal on aria-invalid.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-label { display: flex; margin-bottom: 6px; font: 500 14px/1 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 32px; min-width: 0; padding: 4px 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: var(--radius); font: 400 14px/1.43 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--destructive); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive) 20%, transparent); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--input) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Account Card
components.description: A clickable card: hairline border, whisper shadow, acknowledges hover with a warmer border and one more shadow step.
components.html: Current account20-00-00 · 12345678£2,418.40Pret A Manger−£4.85

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: A linen pill with a category dot; 11px cocoa text.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; background: var(--muted); color: var(--muted-foreground); border-radius: 9999px; font: 500 0.7rem/1.33 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; flex-shrink: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Malai looks like a calm, well-run high-street bank. The canvas is warm paper, the ink is espresso, and there is exactly one brand colour, used the way a good bank uses its brand: on the sign above the door, on the card in your hand, and on the button that moves money. Everything else is tone. Rules are hairlines, surfaces sit flat on the page, figures line up in tabular columns. Nothing bounces, nothing glows, and nothing tries to entertain; the system earns trust by being exact.

The same institution runs the back office. Ops and Exec pin the default malai token set, swap the customer's bottom tabs for a wider container and a text table, and add monospace identifiers and square-cornered status tags. That is the whole difference. Walk from `/` into `/ops` and the type, spacing, borders and controls are the ones you just left; only the density and the vocabulary change. The theme switcher (halcyon, linden) reskins the customer side alone, so the constancy of the back office is a visible fact rather than a claim.

The look is deliberately not a neon challenger bank (no gradients-as-decoration, no glass, no mascots, no confetti), not a developer dashboard (no dark-by-default admin chrome, no monospace outside identifiers, no sidebars on the customer side), and not a legacy bank portal (no navy-and-grey tables, no tiny type, no dated iconography).
keyCharacteristics: Warm, calm, exact: cream paper, espresso ink, one accent, tabular figures everywhere money or ids appear.
Flat by default: hairline borders and tone carry structure; a real shadow means the element has left the page.
One type family (Inter Variable) at one small body size (14px), with weight and tracking doing the hierarchy work.
Three fictional brands as skins: palette and corner radius change, nothing else does.
Honesty as a visual rule: an em-dash for an absent number, a dashed panel for an empty or failed state, a refusal rendered as a fact rather than an error.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Each theme has exactly one hue that is not the paper's. It goes on the wordmark, the primary button, the active tab, links and the focus ring, and on nothing decorative. Secondary, muted, accent and border are all mixed from the canvas hue.

rules.name: The Money Direction Rule
rules.body: Credits are Credit Green with a `+`. Debits are plain Espresso Ink with a `−`, never red. Brick Refusal marks a refusal or a destructive action, never a debit.

rules.name: The Skins Rule
rules.body: A theme changes the palette block and `--radius`. It does not change type, spacing, shadows, iconography or layout. The Ops and Exec surfaces pin the malai block and show no switcher.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Money, sort codes, account numbers, counts, timestamps and identifiers are always `tabular-nums`. Columns of figures must align without effort.

rules.name: The Two Sizes Rule
rules.body: A row's primary line is 16px and everything supporting it is 14px. Do not drift supporting text up to 16px for comfort; the density is the bank. Do not set primaries or inputs below 16px; that is the mobile floor.

rules.name: The One H1 Rule
rules.body: One h1 per page, 24px by default, 30px on a landing page, `tabIndex={-1}` with no visible outline, and it receives focus on arrival.

rules.name: The Off-The-Page Rule
rules.body: A Held or Floating shadow is reserved for elements that overlay other content. Nothing in the document flow gets more than Whisper at rest or Acknowledge on hover.

rules.name: The Dashed Panel Rule
rules.body: Empty states and request failures are a dashed Hairline border on a hero-radius panel with centred Soft Cocoa body text. No illustration, no colour, no shadow.

dos: Do set every money figure, count, identifier and timestamp in `tabular-nums`, and give credits a leading `+` in Credit Green.
Do render an absent figure as an em-dash with a screen-reader "Unavailable", and a pending one as a pulsing Warm Linen block (`bg-muted/40`).
Do use the 1px Hairline border and a tonal step for structure; reserve Held and Floating shadows for menus, dialogs, sheets and the bank card.
Do keep controls at 32px with a pointer and 44px on a coarse pointer (`pointer-coarse:`), with the theme `lg` radius, a 3px 50% ring on focus and a 1px press.
Do reference colour through the semantic tokens (`bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`), never a literal Tailwind hue; the ESLint rule enforces it and the theme switch depends on it.
Do wrap every animation in `motion-safe:` and give it a reduced-motion fallback that lands on the final state.
Do give every page one focusable h1 and, on the Ops surface, show an identifier shortened in mono with the full id a copy away.
Do render empty and failed states as a dashed Hairline panel with centred Soft Cocoa text, and a refusal as a designed inline fact rather than a toast.
donts: Don't introduce a second hue per theme. Accent, secondary and muted are tints of the paper; the brand colour is the only ink.
Don't colour a debit red or use Brick Refusal for anything that is not a refusal, an error or a destructive action.
Don't put a solid red fill on a destructive button; it is a 10% tint with coloured text.
Don't add a theme switcher, a customer skin or a bottom tab bar to the Ops or Exec surfaces; they pin the malai tokens and use the desktop text nav.
Don't vary typography per theme, and don't load a second family; Inter Variable is app-wide and the only monospace is for Ops identifiers.
Don't drift body copy up from 14px, and don't use Display sizes on a heading; the largest type is always a figure.
Don't use a skeleton shimmer, a zero or a hardcoded value where a real number is missing.
Don't add hover lift, scale, glow, glassmorphism, decorative gradients, mascots or confetti; the card art's diagonal gradient is the one exception and stays there.
Don't use a real card-scheme mark or name; the scheme is VELA.
